speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I hear you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. To determine the cause, have you noticed any recent fevers or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma

Given your significant weight loss, night sweats, and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, I suspect a malignancy. Can you tell me if you have noticed any lumps in your neck, armpits, or groin, or have you had a recent tick bite or exposure to a cat?
